Reliable Plumbing Services for Norfolk and the Greater Area

What Emergency Plumbing Service Involves 

Emergency plumbing covers any problem that cannot wait: water where it should not be, a fixture that will not stop running, or hot water that will not come back on. The cause of the failure determines the fix, so a licensed plumber diagnoses the problem first, explains what is wrong and what it will cost, and then makes the repair. Getting the diagnosis right the first time is what keeps a small problem from becoming a repeat call. 

Russell’s American Mechanical handles the plumbing emergencies Norfolk homeowners and businesses run into most often: 

  • Burst Pipes: Fast frozen and burst pipe repair limits water damage and gets your system back online. 
  • Clogged Drains: Drain clearing restores normal flow instead of masking the symptom. 
  • Leaky Fixtures: A repaired leak stops wasted water and the higher bill that comes with it. 
  • Water Heater Issues: Water heater repair or replacement, whichever restores hot water faster. 
  • Other Urgent Repairs: Comprehensive solutions for unexpected plumbing problems that cannot wait for a routine appointment.

Contact Russell’s American Mechanical Today

Is emergency plumbing service available on weekends and holidays?

Yes. Our phone lines are open 24/7, including weekends and holidays, so you can reach a live team member whenever a plumbing emergency happens. Same-day service is available regardless of the day, and if we cannot provide it, your service call fee is waived.

What plumbing problems count as an emergency?

Burst pipes, major leaks, clogged drains that will not clear, and a complete loss of hot water are all situations that qualify as plumbing emergencies. In general, if the problem is actively causing water damage or leaving you without a working system, it is worth an emergency call rather than waiting for a routine appointment.

What should I do while I wait for a plumber to arrive?

Shut off the water at the main valve if a pipe has burst or a fixture will not stop running. Avoid using the affected drain or fixture, and move any items away from standing water if it is safe to do so. These steps help limit damage until a licensed plumber can diagnose and repair the problem.

How much does emergency plumbing repair cost?

Cost depends on the specific repair, the parts involved, and the extent of the damage. Russell’s American Mechanical provides an upfront quote before any work begins, so the number is on the table before the wrench comes out.

Do you repair or replace water heaters?

Yes. Our licensed plumbers diagnose the problem and recommend whichever option, repair or replacement, gets your hot water back fastest and most reliably. If replacement is the better long-term choice, we will explain why before any work begins.

How can I prevent a plumbing emergency?

Routine plumbing maintenance catches small problems, like a slow drain or a minor leak, before they turn into emergencies. Watch for warning signs such as unusual noises, sudden changes in water pressure, or slow drains, and address them early rather than waiting for a full failure.
